== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 21984, 22727, 22883.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Identification ===
* The results were posted by trooper shark, who had offered to direct the event and already held a Day 2 bye from the Quebec Provincials (p317250); the Day 2 bid list gives the 2008 Quebec Provincials bye to Marc Renaud, the announced tournament director. trooper shark is therefore almost certainly Marc Renaud, but the page does not say so.
=== Left out ===
* Nicolas Boisly's illness and death shortly after the event (p329509): private life.
* Game-by-game results (p329509): summarized, not transcribed.
* Discussion of who could run the event (DarK Bane, Terron).
